授業科目の概要.科目名称: 学術英語・アカデミックライティング
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course will help students learn how to write a clear academic essay in English. Students will learn how to organise their ideas, write strong paragraphs, and support their opinions with reasons and evidence.
Students will also learn how to find and use sources, and how to write a short research essay (600 words). They will write several drafts and improve their writing using feedback from the teacher and classmates.
This course also teaches how to use AI tools (such as ChatGPT) in a responsible way. Students will learn when AI is useful (for example, brainstorming and checking ideas) and when it should not be used (for example, asking AI to write whole paragraphs).
By the end of the course, students will be able to write a clear, well-organised academic essay using their own ideas.
In this course, AI is a tool to support students’ thinking, not to replace their thinking.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、信頼できる情報リソースの強力な論拠とエビデンスによる論述実践を通したライティングスキルの向上を目的とする。教師や他の学生からのフィードバックに基づいて計画、執筆、再執筆を行うライティングプロセスを学ぶことで、将来の学術的および専門的なライティング作業に備える。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to improve students’ writing skills by having them write a research essay featuring strong arguments and evidence from reliable sources. Students will learn a writing process involving planning, writing, and rewriting based on teacher and student feedback. This will prepare students for future academic and professional writing work.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Academic writing, essay structure, paragraph writing, research skills, critical thinking, AI literacy, Idea-Reason-Evidence
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
A2-B1 CEFR
No previous experience of writing an English essay is required.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他:
AI Use in This Course:
- AI tools (such as ChatGPT) can help learning, but they must not replace individual thinking.
Students are expected to develop their own ideas and thinking throughout the course.
AI CAN be used for:
brainstorming ideas
asking questions
checking understanding
AI CANNOT be used for:
writing any part of the essay
generating sentences or paragraphs that are submitted as student work
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: 注意: 生成AIは執筆の際に役立つツールとなりえます。しかし、生成AIはあくまで補助として使用し、代替ツールとして利用することは認められません。生成AIの言葉をコピーして自分が書いたふりをすることは、それが授業で直接許可されない限り、盗作（いわゆるカンニング）と見なされます。生成AIやその他類似のツールのコピーは、得点を失う原因となります。さらに深刻な場合、不合格となる可能性があります。授業によって、生成AIの使用時期や方法について他のルールを設定する場合があります。Notes: Generative AI can be a useful tool when writing. However, generative AI should only be used to help you, never to do work for you. Copying words from generative AI and pretending that you wrote them is considered to be plagiarism (a kind of cheating) unless your instructor directly says it is allowed. Copying from generative AI or any other place will cause you to lose points. If the problem is serious enough, you may fail the class. Your instructor may set other rules about when and how generative AI can be used.
